title: Canucks trade Nils Höglander to Predators for 2029 third-round pick
content:
The Vancouver Canucks have traded winger Nils Höglander to the Nashville Predators for a third-round pick.

Höglander, 25, has scored 120 points in 331 career NHL games. Between injuries and inconsistent play, he was limited to five points in 38 games during the 2025-26 season. He’s entering the second year of a three-year contract with a $3 million cap hit.

The pick the Canucks are receiving from Nashville is in the 2029 NHL Draft and originally belonged to the Colorado Avalanche.

This story will be updated.
